title: Home4Us
description:
You’ve completed all the tasks I assigned excellent. Only one simple task remains. Your objective is clear go to my house, head to the office, and send me the files on my device. And this is what he said

Inspect every room before entering. There are rules and sounds you must not ignore. The rooms are not as empty as they appear. Use what you have: a recorder that emits loud noise to drive away anything that approaches you. Stay highly aware of your surroundings. Act quickly delay is not an option. Your protection weakens when the power goes out. And never ignore the rules.

Home4us – pilot 

Gameplay Features• A psychological horror experience focused on tension and fast decision-making during encounters

• Your objective is to deliver files from the office while facing a threat in every room and following strict rules

• Use sound recording mechanics and your flashlight to survive

• A dynamic enemy that changes its behavior and attack patterns rapidly

• A short but intense experience (30–60 minutes)

Support

• If you encounter any issues, have questions, or would like to share feedback or suggestions, feel free to contact me directly via the email I provided. (home4us.support@gmail.com)
description_short: A different kind of horror experience one built on confrontation rather than running or hiding. Follow the rules strictly. Act quickly to stay alive in every encounter. Maintain your focus. Watch your surroundings. Don’t exhaust your resources. And complete the primary objective you’re there for.
